title: Test Motion → Trace → Shape on real browsers
objective: Verify the HTML application renders correctly and all controls work across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
scope: Verify rendering of layout, graphs, and visuals
Test all interactive controls: Play, Pause, Step, time slider, parameter selectors
Identify any rendering or interaction issues
restrictions: Do not modify the HTML or JavaScript
Do not upload files to third-party sites

inputs.name: Motion-Trace-Shape.html
inputs.how_to_access: Download from GitHub or clone repository

deliverables.name: Browser test report
acceptance_criteria: Report covers at least two browser/OS combinations

beneficiaries.name: Educators
beneficiaries.impact: Confidence the tool works in classrooms

required_skills: Ability to describe what works and doesn't work
required_permissions: Access to at least two different browsers
stop_conditions: HTML file is corrupted or inaccessible
You do not have access to at least two browsers
Testing requires payment or account creation
how_to_start: 1. Clone the repository. 2. Download Motion-Trace-Shape.html from tools/motion-trace-shape/. 3. Open in first browser and test all controls. 4. Document results. 5. Repeat in second browser. 6. Submit report.
how_to_submit: Create a file docs/test-reports/browser-test-[your-name]-[date].md with your report and open a pull request.
